official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Create 3D models from a text description or image without leaving your conversation. Creations3D shows each result in an interactive viewer, so you can rotate and inspect your model before downloading it.

Create a model, check its progress, browse your existing models, and request an export for your project. Supported exports include GLB, OBJ, FBX, STL and 3MF. Your account keeps your models and available credits together across the website and connected tools.

A Creations3D account with generation credits is required.
